thought.text: The virtual device is already up and running (`emulator-5554  device`) ✅. The build failed because `--no-enable-impeller` is a `flutter run` flag and can't be used with `flutter build`. Restarting the build without this flag:

reasoning_content:
The emulator has started, and `emulator-5554` is in the "device" state — the virtual device requirement is satisfied.

The build failed: `--no-enable-impeller` is not a valid option for `flutter build apk` (it's a `flutter run` flag). Restarting the build without this flag.

action.command: export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && cd /workspace && nohup fvm flutter build apk --flavor ni --dart-define=PARTNER=ni --dart-define=cronetHttpNoPlay=true > /tmp/build_ni.log 2>&1 & echo "build pid $!"
